_what: ADR r3-0007 option-C follow-up (execution plan step 5): is mf_fno_transfer_film's ifc_heat win real field structure or offset calibration?
_method: Reloaded the 3 certified seed checkpoints (jobs 171858-60, ckpt/result mtimes 2026-08-10 11:08-11:09), forward pass on the round-2 stripped view via the family's own loaders and scaler (replicating smoke_eval.py::run byte-for-byte in data prep). Raw metric validated against film_denominator.json; mean-removed metric subtracts each sample's spatial mean from prediction and target independently, then recomputes rel-L2. Floors recomputed from benchmark_42/core/ifc_heat fidelity_64 exactly per make_round3_anchors.py::ifc_floors (same nrmse convention). Both conventions reported: per-sample-mean rel-L2 (the round's ONE definition, used for the verdict and matching ifc_floors) and aggregate ratio-of-sums nRMSE (the convention film_denominator's per-seed ifc values are recorded in).

Both are reported here; verdict uses per-sample-mean, the same convention as the ifc_floors records.

advantage_ratio_best_floor_over_film.note: best floor = affine_on_hf_train in both views; ratio > 1 means film is better; the advantage GROWS slightly under mean removal (2.60x -> 2.79x).

verdict_reasoning: ifc_heat is confirmed level-dominated (88.5% of the mean target norm sits in the per-sample constant offset), so the concern was legitimate. But mean removal does not erase film's win: film's mean-removed per-sample rel-L2 is 0.0547 (worst seed 0.0640) against 0.1526 for the best mean-removed floor (affine_on_hf_train), 0.2098 for nn_condition and 0.2698 for train_mean - every seed individually beats every floor with a >2x margin, and film's advantage ratio over the best floor slightly INCREASES from 2.60x (raw) to 2.79x (mean-removed). Film also beats the oracle affine residual level (0.0377 raw) in raw units, i.e. it captures nonlinear-in-condition field structure no affine offset model can. The win is real fluctuation-field structure, not offset calibration; ADR r3-0007 option C stands and option B does not need to be activated on this evidence.
